blocks.content:
Article 6 deals with persons who migrated from Pakistan to India.

A person became a citizen if:

• He migrated before 19 July 1948 and was ordinarily resident in India, or

• He migrated after 19 July 1948 and was registered as a citizen.



This article is based on historical context of Partition.
A person who has migrated to the territory of India from the territory now included in Pakistan shall be deemed to be a citizen of India at the commencement of this Constitution.

rows: Mandatory registration by an officer appointed by the Government
Ordinarily resident in India since the date of migration
Must reside in India for at least 6 months immediately preceding the application
Granted citizenship only upon approval of the registration application

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 6 confers citizenship rights on persons who migrated from Pakistan to India at the time of Partition.
The applicant, or either of their parents, or any of their grandparents must have been born in undivided India as defined in the Government of India Act, 1935.
July 19, 1948, serves as the critical cut-off date due to the introduction of the permit system for resettlement.
Migrants entering India before July 19, 1948, automatically became citizens if they were ordinarily resident in India since their migration.
Migrants entering on or after July 19, 1948, had to register as citizens after residing in India for a minimum of six months preceding their application.
July 19, 1948 is frequently tested in prelims as the specific date when the permit system for migration from Pakistan came into force.
For migrants entering on or after July 19, 1948, a mandatory continuous residence of at least six months prior to registration is required.
The definition of 'undivided India' under Article 6 relies strictly on the Government of India Act, 1935.

blocks.content:
Article 7 applies to persons who migrated to Pakistan after 1 March 1947.



Such persons were generally not considered citizens of India, unless they later returned under a permit for resettlement.
